jid.description: The JID (Jabber ID) used by the XMPP client to authenticate and send alerts.

password.description: The password for the JID used to authenticate with the XMPP server.

to_jid.description: The destination JID (Jabber ID) where alerts should be sent.

listen_address.description: The IP address on which the service listens for incoming Prometheus webhooks.

listen_port.description: The port on which the service listens for incoming Prometheus webhooks.
